sso.title: Administrator authentication
sso.scope: Installation-wide OIDC configuration. Activating a verified snapshot enables SSO login and creates ordinary user accounts on first login. It never grants administrator privileges. Local administrator recovery remains independent. Register both callback URLs documented in docs/sso.md.
sso.callback: Register this exact callback URL in your provider application:
sso.loginCallback: Also register this exact user-login callback URL:
sso.domains: Use a standard *.auth0.com, *.okta.com, *.oktapreview.com or *.okta-emea.com hostname (no URL/custom domain). Entra ID requires a tenant GUID. Tests use authorization code + PKCE and open the provider's authentication page.
sso.name: Display name
sso.server: Okta authorization server ID (default or custom ID)
sso.secretPresent: A secret is stored; its value is never displayed.
sso.secretAbsent: No secret is stored (use a public PKCE client if your provider supports it).
sso.saved: Draft saved. Test this revision before activation; the previous active configuration is unchanged.
sso.activated: Verified configuration activated. Users can sign in through this provider on the login page.
sso.deactivated: Provider deactivated. Local administrator access is unchanged.
sso.testSuccess: Authorization code exchange and ID token validation succeeded. Refresh shows server-verified status; activate explicitly when ready.

login.title: Sign in
login.policy: Sign in with an active provider. Your ordinary user account is created on first login; this never grants administrator access.
login.empty: No SSO providers are active. Contact your platform administrator.

errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed or expired. Try again; contact your administrator if the problem persists.
errors.email_collision: This email already belongs to another account. Accounts are never linked by email. Ask your provider administrator to supply a distinct email or omit the email claim.
errors.request_failed: Unable to load sign-in providers. Check your connection and reload.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

errors.invalid_provider: Invalid provider details. Check the standard hostname or tenant GUID, authorization server, client ID and secret update.
errors.revision_conflict: The draft changed in another session. Refresh and reopen it before continuing.
errors.test_required: The current revision must pass a connection test before activation.
errors.deactivate_required: Deactivate this provider before deleting it.
errors.connection_failed: Connection test failed or expired. Check callback URL, issuer, credentials, application permissions and provider authentication; save changes and retry. Local login and the previous active configuration are unchanged.
errors.deployment_configuration: The operator must configure Authentication:Sso:PublicApiBaseUrl and Authentication:Sso:FrontendOrigin before testing.
errors.request_failed: Request failed. Check your administrator session and connection, then refresh or retry.
